description:
Design and develop highly scalable, usable, and distributed applications using Microsoft .NET technologies - Development using C#, .Net, MVC5, CSS, AJAX, JQuery, SQL Server for new applications and enhancements to existing applications - Demonstrate understanding of software development methodologies, design patterns, and database design - Ability to work timely and efficiently in a rapidly‐changing environment - Work closely with team members, operations, and other internal stakeholders - Proactively seeks opportunities to implement improvements to internal processes - Analyze and troubleshoot application issues - Demonstrate excellent written and oral communication skills - Good interpersonal skills to interact with team members and management 

 3+ years experience analyzing, designing and implementing integration solutions using Microsoft .NET technologies - Solid experience developing applications using MVC3/MVC4/MVC5 architecture, atleast 2 projects. ASP.Net, C#, SQL Server required.  - Experience developing UI layers using CSS,AJAX, JQuery, HTML is required. - Working knowledge of Visual Studio 2010 & 2012 & SQL Server - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience in related field - Microsoft certification preferred  - Excellent Communication skills.
